name: Tool-Calling Normalization
description: Normalize tool-calling across providers. Convert between OpenAI function calling, Anthropic tool use, and Gemini function calling formats. A tool definition is written once in the neutral format and rendered into each provider's native schema. Tool call results from any provider are returned in a normalized shape.
purpose: Abstract away the syntactic differences in how each provider handles tool calling, so tool integrations work identically regardless of which backend is serving the request.
acceptanceCriteria: Neutral tool definition format that captures: name, description, parameters (JSON Schema), strict mode flag
Renders into OpenAI tool schema format
Renders into Anthropic tool use format
Renders into Google Gemini function declaration format
Normalized tool call result: toolName, args, toolUseId, raw provider response
Parallel tool calls supported where provider allows it
Tool choice mode (auto, required, none, specific) normalized across providers
Automatic conversion of JSON Schema features not supported by a given provider (e.g., stripping $ref, enums where unsupported)
